const jobs = $input.first().json.jobs; const batches = []; for (let i=0;i<jobs.length;i+=100) batches.push({json:{jobs:jobs.slice(i,i+100)}}); return batches.length ? batches : [{json:{jobs:[]}}];

const data = $('Normalize Jobs').first().json; const batches = $('Build Batches').all(); const errors = [...data.errors]; let stored=0; $input.all().forEach((item,i)=>{ if(item.json.error || item.json.statusCode >= 400 || !item.json.statusCode) errors.push('Batch '+(i+1)+' upsert failed'); else stored+=batches[i].json.jobs.length; }); return [{json:{status:errors.length?'failed':'completed',jobs_found:data.jobs_found,jobs_upserted:stored,error_message:errors.length?errors.join('; '):null,completed_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
